items.name: exact-semiprimes-lean
items.description: Lean 4/Mathlib proof that almost all intervals (x, x+(log x)^c], c > 3688/1763 ≈ 2.0919, contain exact semiprimes, beating Matomäki–Teräväinen's 2.1. Assumes: 13 cited published theorems (Guth–Maynard, Heath-Brown, Hildebrand–Tenenbaum, Iwaniec–Kowalski, Luca–Tóth, Matomäki–Teräväinen) + 5 labelled parameter extensions of MT23 lemmas. No sorry.

items.name: NPCompleteness-Lean4
items.description: Lean 4 proofs, using only Lean core, that SAT, 3-SAT, exactly-3-SAT, (≤1,≤2)-SAT, binary-index SAT, planar 3-SAT and Lichtenstein's planar 3-SAT are NP-complete for an explicit Turing-machine model, and that NP equals nondeterministic polynomial time. Prepared for the Palomar registry.
